introHtml: White flashing blinky lights provide high visibility in low-light conditions, making them ideal for safety giveaways or event branding. Options like the Light Up Hard Hat Keytag or Bottle Opener Key Light combine utility with brand exposure. Customize with your logo using pad printing or laser engraving for a clean finish that stands out on job sites or at night events.
